children: Blue Owl Technology Finance entered into a Note Purchase Agreement to issue $150 million of 7.60% Series 2026A Senior Notes due September 3, 2032 to qualified institutional investors. The unsecured notes feature semiannual interest payments and customary covenants, with optional redemption and change-of-control prepayment provisions. Interest may step up by up to 2.00% upon specified rating or secured debt ratio events. The company expects the financing to bolster liquidity and support long-term investment activities.
: Private placement of 7.60% senior unsecured notes (Series 2026A)
: Raise long-term fixed-rate capital and diversify funding
